thread:
Maya (product): quick sync — proposing a compact entry/gate matrix + phased-sunset flow for catalog entries. need eng/infra/cs take on thresholds, migration hooks, and opt-in windows. TL;DR: aim for predictable cutovers with automation and a customer-friendly gracepath.

Sam (eng): curious — can you sketch the matrix? what are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

Maya (product): sure. rough proposal: minimal entry: checksum + perf bench (p50/p99 on target hw), token-efficiency metric, inference contract docs. gate: pass perf & stability tests, + security scan. optional: compatibility shim for older tokenizers.

Kevin (infra): for perf bench we need standard seq lengths: 32/128/512, payload mix 80% short/20% long. also want KV cache mem footprint numbers.

Olivia (cs): customers will ask about pin TTL and migration windows. propose a default 90d pin TTL, with 30/60/90 day notifications and an opt-in extended gracepath for enterprises.

Beth (customer success): pls add a "soft-cutover" option: traffic split (10/90 -> 50/50 -> 0/100) over 48-72h with an automated rollback if error-rate > 1% or latency regresses > 30%. customers love staged cutovers.

Sam (eng): love the staged cutover idea. need canary automation hooks in the runtime and a simple API:

```json
{
  "canary": true,
  "split": [10,50,100],
  "step_interval_hours": 24,
  "rollback_triggers": {"error_rate_pct": 1, "p99_latency_increase_pct": 30}
}
```

Kevin (infra): ops-bot can enforce the rollback triggers and emit an incident if rollback fires. add circuit-breaker: if model instance OOMs > 2 in 10m, roll back.

ops-bot: noted — will create a monitoring alert template in #eng-infra when we finalize thresholds. :white_check_mark:

Maya (product): on deprecation/migration comms: propose automatic in-console timeline + email for customers with pinned versions. notify at 60/30/14/7/1 days plus post-cutover "what changed" doc.

Olivia (cs): also include a migration-playbook link per-customer with suggested prompt-matching tests and rollback steps. Avoid generic docs.

Beth (customer success): can we offer a migration assistance bundle (paid) for enterprise customers who want hands-on cutover support? covers prompt mapping, canary support, and SLA guardrails.

Sam (eng): implementation concerns: we need a migration-job framework that can (1) run customer prompt suites against both models, (2) summarize semantic drift, and (3) produce a pass/fail signal. probably a week of eng effort + infra workflows.

Kevin (infra): + runtime changes for traffic-splitting and KV cache compatibility shim. estimate 2-3 sprints for end-to-end.

Maya (product): decision asks for this thread: (A) agree on entry checklist fields, (B) confirm pin TTL default 90d + enterprise opt-in, (C) OK to build canary automation with the rollback rules above, (D) approve migration assistance offer for sales to price.

Olivia (cs): +1 on A/B/C. D needs finance input but thumbs-up from CS.

Sam (eng): +1 on A/B/C, can start scoping tasks tomorrow.

Kevin (infra): +1. will draft alert templates and infra tickets.

Beth (customer success): +1 on offering migration assist as opt-in paid addon.

Maya (product): awesome — I'll capture the matrix and ship a PR to the catalog docs today. will create a follow-up with a short RFC for the canary API. thanks all :rocket:

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4821 for monitoring templates and ENG-7398 for canary automation scoping.
